235: def get_activation(name) -> Callable:
236:     if name is None:
237:         return lambda x: x
238:     name = name.lower()
239:     if name == "none":
240:         return lambda x: x
241:     elif name == "exp":
242:         return lambda x: torch.exp(x)
243:     elif name == "sigmoid":
244:         return lambda x: torch.sigmoid(x)
245:     elif name == "tanh":
246:         return lambda x: torch.tanh(x)
247:     elif name == "softplus":
248:         return lambda x: F.softplus(x)
249:     else:
250:         try:
251:             return getattr(F, name)
252:         except AttributeError:
253:             raise ValueError(f"Unknown activation function: {name}")
